summary: Ran 37 backend pytest cases against the deployed API. All 37 passed (100%). Coverage: auth (valid/missing/invalid/malformed/expired token), couple create/join (fresh, idempotent, invalid code, full couple, case-insensitive code, already-linked), couple settings + days_together math, memories validation (>5 photos rejected, 1500-char caption truncation, 60s voice cap, only-author delete, month filter, by-date), Daily Question determinism + persistence, Daily Trivia (real DeepSeek/OpenRouter call, 4 options, chooser, idempotent per day, hidden correct_index until answer, +1 point, no double-answer), Weekly Challenge (auto-generate pending, decline path, cannot complete before accept, +5 points + partner_revealed after completion), Weekly Wager (propose, proposer cannot self-accept, partner accept, decline-then-new-wager allowed, 300-char stake cap, 404 when none), and end-to-end points aggregation (A=6 after correct trivia + completed challenge, B=0). Identified ONE real PRD-violation bug via direct curl: GET /api/daily/question leaks the partner's answer text in the `answers` map even before the viewer has answered (PRD says partner answers must be hidden until you answer).

critical.issue: Privacy leak: the response field `answers` returns ALL partner answers verbatim even when the current user has NOT yet answered (`my_answer: null`). PRD explicitly says partner answers must be hidden until you answer. Reproduced via curl: B posts "B_SECRET_ANSWER", A's GET returns `answers: {user_test_bbb2: "B_SECRET_ANSWER"}, my_answer: null`. Fix: in server.py `daily_question()` and `answer_daily_question()`, only include partner entries in `answers` after the current user has answered, or replace partner values with a sentinel (e.g. "—" / `null` / `"hidden"`).

minor.issue: `gen_invite_code()` produces 6-char codes with no retry on unique-index collision. Although extremely rare (32^6), an unhandled duplicate would surface as a 500. Consider a retry loop on DuplicateKeyError.
Hard limit of 500 documents returned with no pagination. Acceptable for MVP but should be revisited as memories accrue.

Fallback path (when OpenRouter fails or returns malformed JSON) always uses the same Mars question. If LLM hiccups, both partners see the identical canned question. Suggest rotating a fallback bank similar to CHALLENGE_FALLBACKS.

When the SAME user re-submits a code for a couple they are already a member of, the endpoint silently returns 200 with the serialized couple instead of the documented 400 "already linked". Behavior is harmless but inconsistent with the error message defined elsewhere.

action_items: Fix daily-question partner-answer leak: in server.py `daily_question()` (GET) and `answer_daily_question()` (POST), strip partner entries from the returned `answers` dict whenever the current user's answer is missing. Return only `{user_id: text}` for the caller, or replace others with `null`/hidden until both have answered.
(Optional) Add DuplicateKeyError retry to `couple_create` invite-code generation.
(Optional) Expand trivia fallback bank to avoid identical Mars question when OpenRouter fails.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 757 lines; consider splitting into routers/modules (auth, couple, memories, daily, weekly) once stable.
`daily_question` returns full `answers` dict without gating on viewer-has-answered — PRD violation (see HIGH issue above).
`_id` correctly excluded everywhere via `{"_id": 0}` projections; serialization helpers also clean.
Async/await usage on Motor is correct throughout; no sync blocking calls in handlers.
All env vars (MONGO_URL, DB_NAME, OPENROUTER_API_KEY) read from os.environ; no hardcoded URLs.
Pydantic models validate every request body; HTTPException codes (400/401/404) are semantically correct.
seed_data_creation: Ran /app/backend/seed_test.py to (re)seed partner.a@test.com (token testtoken_partner_a) and partner.b@test.com (token testtoken_partner_b). Tests then clean couple/memories/trivia/challenges/wagers/question_answers collections per fixture and re-link the seeded users for happy-path flows.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Test suite lives at /app/backend/tests/. Run with: `cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/ -v --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml`. The `linked_couple` fixture wipes couple-dependent collections then creates+joins a fresh couple for each test using it — so tests can mutate state freely. BASE_URL resolves from EXPO_BACKEND_URL, falling back to EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env. Trivia tests make real OpenRouter calls (one per generate test, ~3 calls total, ~3-5s each).
